message:
1 helper(s) taken from the suite's own modules by a name no definition in the corpus carries:
      card.spec.ts:2 — `colourOf`, imported from `./support/css`
    Every
why: The hovered card's race, read through `styleOf` imported as `colourOf`. The corpus defines `styleOf`, and a vocabulary matches a helper by the name a call writes, so as far as point 3 can tell `colourOf(…)` reads nothing and the race goes by unreported — the definition is in the corpus and the name the spec calls it by is not. `swatch.spec.ts` defines a `colourOf` of its own, and that is no reason to know this one: a helper name is file-local, and only what the support tree defines is shared.
